selection: Use the support-trained arm if the frozen development receipt confirms a positive paired count and no regression. Otherwise admit only an arm that passes all original functional and retention gates.
requirements: Retain all seven original functional and physical safety gates, exact native start per seed, and zero backward net loss.
Use the same fixed forward route, fixed non-right policy, and inference batch shapes for every arm.
Check an independent development seed before replication. Run any training replication from the same parent and shared critic with matched samples, noise, and actor-retention settings.
The final holdout remains sealed until the chosen policy, model hash, scoring gates and replication evidence are pinned.
Keep the result of this training iteration separate from evidence of a reproducible effect of the added credit.
